:::: {.hero}
# Practitioner Exchange

::: {.stand}
A facilitation retreat. Knowing your practice well is one thing. Leading a group
is another.
:::
::::

This three-to-four-day retreat gives around twelve wellness, bodymind and
movement practitioners a place to practise group facilitation with other
practitioners.
Each participant leads a session in their own practice and then receives
structured, compassionate feedback. Along the way, you experience other
traditions from the inside and compare notes on what it takes to lead a group
well.

We look after the structure: daily opening and closing practices, a short check-in
with you before you lead, and a safe container for reflection. That leaves you
free to try new things, take risks and grow as a facilitator.

:::: {.about}

::: {.ab}
[Who it is for]{.k}

Teachers, therapists and practitioners who want to lead groups with more
confidence, presence and care.
:::

::: {.ab}
[When]{.k}

Tentatively May 2027. Three to four days.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Where]{.k}

Germany.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Touch]{.k}

Some sessions may involve touch between participants, such as a hand on the
back or leaning into each other's weight, including sessions that other
participants lead. Touch is always optional: you can say no, or change your
mind, at any time without giving a reason, and there is always a way to take
part without it. Nothing in the retreat is sexual, and everyone stays clothed.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Language]{.k}

English.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Group]{.k}

Around twelve participants.
:::

::::

::: {.empty}
Venue, exact dates and price to follow.

::: {.empty}
This retreat is not therapy or medical treatment. If you have a physical or
mental health condition, please tell us before booking, so we can talk it
through together.
:::
